Rajasthan Safai Karamchari Recruitment 2026: The Local Self Government Department will close the online application process for the posts of Sanitation worker on October 28, 2026. Interested candidates can submit their online application through the official recruitment portal at lsg.rajasthan.gov.in. The official notification for these posts was released on July 27, 2026 . Then the online applications process was started from August 15, 2026. Initially the last date to submit the online application was October 13, 2026. In order to provide another chance the last date was extended again. Under this recruitment drive a total of 24,752 posts i.e 24,277 in the Non-Scheduled Area and 475 vacancies in Scheduled Areas would be filled . Selected candidates will receive a monthly honorarium Rs 7,410/-
In this article you will find all the important things related to the application process, eligibility criteria, application fees and more details.

The official notification issued under the Advt No 01/2026. The selection process comprises the Category-wise merit list prepared through a lottery system , followed by document verification and a medical exam. Check the details related to the recruitment drive in the table below.
